name: Spirit Glaive hits an enemy 38 degrees off the Witch Doctor's facing (#8914)
contract: Every Spirit Glaive rank (806289, 680906, 562715-562719) targets TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24 with a 30 yd radius.
Without a spell_cone row the core read the enum suffix as 24 degrees (+/-12), so enemies inside the client's
90 degree cone marker (ConeSplat_Static_90d_30yd) were skipped, as #8914 reports. The first-rank spell_cone row
restores 90 degrees (+/-45) for the chain, as for Flames of Xoroth, Dreadwake and Dawnbreak. The harness places
the target only along +x, so the doctor turns in place. Expected: the target straight ahead and 38 degrees off
the facing (outside 24, inside 90) receives the glaive debuff; at 60 degrees off it does not.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Bow for the glaive's ranged-weapon requirement
CONTROL: Spirit Glaive facing the target
CONTROL: a target straight ahead receives the glaive debuff
Turn 38 degrees away from the target
DISCRIMINATING: Spirit Glaive with the target 38 degrees off facing
#8914: the 90 degree cone hits a target the 24 degree cone missed
Turn 60 degrees away from the target
CONTROL: Spirit Glaive with the target 60 degrees off facing
Let the cast and the glaive's travel finish
CONTROL: a target outside the 90 degree cone is not hit
